subject_session: Achilles_10252013 (primary) plus Cicero_09012014, Cicero_09172014, Gatsby_08022013, Buddy_06272013; 3 ring-track sessions excluded

headline_stat.name: fraction of place fields with significant negative phase-position slope; median slope

stated_limitation: One methodological caveat is worth stating: fields were taken from the pooled direction-specific rate map rather than lap by lap, and spikes were pooled across laps, so lap-to-lap variability in where a field begins adds phase jitter. The reported correlations are therefore, if anything, a lower bound on the strength of precession within single traversals.

justification.dataset: DANDI:000044 (hc-11, Grosmark & Buzsaki) dorsal CA1 linear-track recordings are the canonical dataset for theta entrainment and phase precession, and the agent used five sessions across four rats.
justification.handling: Data were streamed with LINDI, units filtered by the file's excitatory/inhibitory label plus explicit spike-count, peak-rate and spatial-information criteria, and three real NWB conversion pitfalls (rate-as-period, a mostly-NaN stored linearized series, gap-bridging derivatives) were identified, worked around, and cross-validated at r = 0.99999.
justification.analysis: Circular statistics are used correctly throughout (Rayleigh test, Kempter circular-linear regression with a within-field phase permutation null), and the leftward-run coordinate reversal that many analyses get wrong was caught and fixed, though the permutation control was only run in one of the five sessions and no multiple-comparison correction is applied.
justification.correctness: Every headline number reproduces exactly from the committed pickle and all three headline statistics fall inside the preregistered ranges, with no internal contradictions between text, figures and code.
justification.figures: The precession band is unmistakable in the single-field examples, the pooled density maps and the across-session panel, axes carry units, sample sizes are given, and examples are ranked by circular-linear correlation rather than slope; only cosmetic faults remain (a 1.6 m title over a 1.9 m axis, an unexplained reference cosine).
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate to what the figures show, the excluded ring-track sessions are named and justified with a dedicated figure, and the pooled-lap field definition is flagged as a specific limitation with its expected direction of bias.
justification.verdict: This is a careful, reproducible, well-documented demonstration of both phenomena on the canonical dataset that I would take and move on from.
